mintAuthority.summary: USD3 user shares mint against USDC deposits; report-time fee and profit-lock shares are computed from strategy NAV gains, not an administrator-selected unbacked amount. A 3-of-5 3Jane Safe controls a one-day configuration timelock that can raise deposit capacity or exempt self-deposit receivers without bypassing the asset transfer. A separate seven-day timelock owns the proxy admin and can replace mint-critical implementation logic; that upgrade-only power is outside the D14 cap trigger.

controls.label: USD3 deposit-mint vault
controls.capDescription: ERC-4626 shares are minted only against USDC deposits; the reviewed implementation exposes no privileged unbacked mint path.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095802, asset() returned canonical USDC and the EIP-1967 implementation was source-verified USD3 0xd1f1c3f485063712873285bf4ef25ab068f13893. Deposits mint ERC-4626 shares against USDC; management can exempt self-deposit receivers from the ordinary supply cap, but this does not create an unbacked mint path.

controls.label: USD3 protocol configuration timelock
controls.capDescription: ProtocolConfig held a 100,000,000 USDC supply cap and 100% max-on-credit setting at block 26095802; management can exempt self-deposit receivers from ordinary supply-cap headroom.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095802, ProtocolConfig getUsd3SupplyCap() returned 100000000000000, getMaxOnCredit() returned 10000, and owner() returned this timelock. Its getMinDelay() returned 86400. Safe 0x33333333bd7045f1a601a1e289d7ab21036fb5ef held proposer, executor, and canceller roles; USD3 management() returned this timelock.

controls.label: USD3 proxy upgrade timelock
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 26095802, the correct EIP-1967 admin slot resolved to 0x41c838664a9c64905537ff410333b9f5964cc596. Its owner() returned this timelock, whose getMinDelay() returned 604800; the current 3Jane Safe held proposer, executor, and canceller roles.

controls.label: 3Jane governance Safe
controls.evidence: Pinned Ethereum reads at block 26095802 confirmed five owners, threshold three, VERSION() 1.3.0, no enabled modules, zero guard and module-guard storage, and fallback handler 0xf48f2b2d2a534e402487b3ee7c18c33aec0fe5e4. This issuer-listed Safe holds proposer, executor, and canceller roles on both timelocks. USD3 management is the one-day timelock; keeper() is 0xc22158100b823e1ef612fba265941efe9e7d7975. The previously recorded Safe address returned empty data for getOwners() and getThreshold().

capSemanticsReview.rationale: D14 review of verified USD3 implementation 0xd1f1c3f485063712873285bf4ef25ab068f13893 and its fixed TokenizedStrategy singleton 0xd377919fa87120584b21279a491f82d5265a139c: deposit/mint calls _deposit, transferring USDC before minting shares. Configuration management can increase supply capacity or exempt self-deposit receivers, but cannot bypass that transfer or authorize an arbitrary share minter. Report fee and profit-lock shares are computed from strategy-reported NAV, not a privileged arbitrary amount mint; USD3 harvestAndReport returns live nav(). Proxy upgrades remain separate from D14. Inherited USDC issuer power is carried by the parent dependency edge, not charged again to USD3.
